jobs.occupation: Senior Commercial Lead – MedTech Startup
jobs.description:
oasicare is looking for an entrepreneurial senior commercial lead to take our women’s health medical device from early clinical adoption to scalable commercial growth.

We are a Danish medtech company developing solutions to improve outcomes in vaginal birth. Our first product, ASISU, is a CE-marked medical device designed to reduce the risk of perineal tears during childbirth. We are already working with leading maternity wards and clinical partners and are now entering the next phase: turning clinical traction into hospital-wide adoption, commercial partnerships, and international growth.

The role

As senior commercial lead, you will own oasicare’s commercial strategy, market development, revenue delivery and commercial organisation.

Your initial mandate is to determine how the existing distributor, direct-to-hospital and consumer-driven opportunities should be combined and sequenced by market. You will then lead execution of the optimal strategy.

You will personally own critical customers, hospitals and distributor relationships, early commercial experiments and major negotiations while building the team and systems required for scale.

Subject to performance, company development and achievement of agreed commercial milestones, the role has the potential to develop into the position of Chief Commercial Officer following a structured evaluation, expected within 9–12 months.

Lead hospital and market adoption

• Build relationships with maternity wards, clinicians, hospital management, procurement teams and relevant professional organisations.

• Convert clinical interest into agreed implementation pathways, trained users, product availability, utilisation and recurring orders.

• Define the role hospitals play in each go-to-market model: customer, clinical adopter, service provider, access partner or demand enabler.

• Personally lead strategically important early accounts and partnerships.

Advance and activate a suitable distributor strategy

• Validate partner fit, commitment, commercial terms, evidence expectations, country access and launch capabilities.

• Negotiate, appoint, onboard and manage distributors in markets where this is the preferred route.

• Establish country plans, training, marketing support, order commitments and performance expectations.

• Measure partner performance through hospital access, activation, sales-through and adoption, not only distributor purchases.

Advance and activate consumer-funded, hospital-enabled model

• Design and test the end-to-end journey from consumer awareness and purchase to hospital acceptance and clinical use.

• Validate willingness to pay, pricing, acquisition cost, conversion, contribution margin, fulfilment and customer support.

• Establish practical onboarding and operating arrangements with participating hospitals and maternity wards.

• Ensure consumer communications, clinical education and promotional claims remain aligned with regulatory requirements and the available evidence.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with a strong track record in medical devices or medtech commercialisation. Experience with women’s health markets is a plus, but not a requirement.

You should understand that selling a regulated healthcare product is very different from selling conventional products and services.

Ideally, you have:

• Significant commercial experience in medical devices, medtech or a closely related healthcare industry.

• Proven experience selling into hospitals and navigating clinical stakeholders, procurement and complex healthcare decision-making.

• A strong understanding of how regulatory requirements and clinical evidence shape commercialisation.

• Experience taking products from early clinical adoption to commercial sales.

• Experience with distributors and international market expansion.

• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills.

• Experience in an entrepreneurial, scale-up or early commercial-stage environment.

• An analytical and structured approach to execution

How you work

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive with humility and clinical credibility.

You are comfortable entering a hospital one day, working through a distributor agreement the next, and testing a new commercial assumption the day after.

You listen to clinicians and customers, challenge assumptions with data, and are willing to change direction when the evidence tells you to.

Most importantly, you want to build a commercial organisation around a product that has the potential to meaningfully improve care for women, so you are a natural-born leader others want to follow

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn and make sure to attach your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience and motivation.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. The right candidate will have the opportunity to build up equity ownership in the company.

If you have any specific questions regarding the position, write an email to Ditte-Marie Ibsen on ditte-marie@oasi.care.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
How will AI transform the way organizations work? At KPMG NewTech, you won't just discuss that question, you'll help answer it. Working with some of Denmark's largest organizations, you will help design AI-native ways of working through our NewPractice methodology, implement AI solutions, and support adoption across the business. If you are interested in emerging technologies, steep learning curves, and the opportunity to shape the future of work, this is the place to do it.

About the role

As a consultant in NewTech, you will help deliver AI transformation projects from strategy to implementation and adoption. You will support clients in rethinking how work gets done through AI, combining technology, change management, and business value creation.

Using our NewPractice methodology, you will help organizations build AI-native ways of working, working closely with clients, supporting project delivery, and contributing to proposals and new ideas. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys learning, and is motivated by ownership and impact.

AI is at the core of how we work. You will actively use AI tools in your daily work, helping us deliver projects smarter, develop new methods faster, and demonstrate effective AI adoption in practice.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Contribute to AI transformation projects end-to-end: scoping, delivery, and adoption.

• 
Work directly with client teams to design AI-native processes using our NewPractice methodology.

• 
Use AI tools regularly in your own work and helping clients and colleagues do the same.

• 
Translate what our technical teams build into something clients understand and want to use.

• 
Support proposals and helping prioritize use cases based on value, feasibility and impact.

• 
Help develop our methods and delivery approach as we scale.

Perks of joining NewTech

At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. Unlike traditional consultants, we not only advise clients on transformation but also help design, build, and implement solutions alongside them. Our projects combine AI, automation, emerging technologies, and organizational change, giving you the opportunity to work across business and technical disciplines while turning ideas into practical solutions.

Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists, and software developers who collaborate closely and learn from one another. Working in cross-functional teams, you will develop both advisory and technology-related skills while gaining experience from colleagues with diverse backgrounds.

What sets NewTech apart is our focus on consulting. From day one, you will help shape solutions, test technologies, and work directly with clients to promote adoption and value realization. It is an ideal environment for those who want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges.

About you, our new team member

You have good analytical skills and enjoy solving business challenges where technology plays a central role. You are motivated by analyzing processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and turning complex problems into actionable solutions. Experience with process mapping, use case development, value assessment, and stakeholder management is an advantage.

You are curious about how AI, automation, and data create business value and are motivated to learn about both the organizational and technical sides of transformation. Most importantly, you are self-motivated, collaborative, and motivated to grow in a fast-evolving field.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Has some background in AI, automation, or digital transformation, whether within strategy, delivery, or change.

• 
Has experience using AI tools in your work or studies, with an interest in developing your AI skills.

• 
Has a structured way of working and the ability to keep projects moving forward.

• 
Is comfortable working in an evolving environment where not everything is defined in advance.

• 
Has a genuine curiosity about AI, its impact on organizations, and emerging trends shaping the business landscape.

• 
Is fluent in English and Danish or another Scandinavian language.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
Describe a project where you solved a challenging problem using data, analytics, automation, or AI. What was the problem, how did you approach it, what did you implement, and what did you learn?

• 
Imagine you need to explain the value of using AI‑enabled ways of working with a client who has never used AI before. How would you approach the conversation and help them understand how AI could support their daily work and decision‑making?

• 
Why are you interested in a business analyst role in NewTech at this stage of your career, and what skills or areas are you most excited to develop?

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Sebastiam S. Jørgensen sjoergensen@kpmg.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

This is a highly visible leadership role with significant influence across the organisation and a direct impact on Saxo's financial crime risk management framework.

You bring strong leadership experience and deep expertise in financial crime prevention, risk management or compliance. You combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities and have successfully led and developed specialist teams in complex environments.

You will help shape the future of Saxo's observability landscape by designing and operating solutions for metrics, logs, traces, and events across cloud and on-premises environments. Your work will enable engineering teams to better understand, monitor, and improve the systems that power Saxo.

Team perspective

"We are the eyes and ears of Saxo Bank's platform health. Our work is critical to maintaining stable and continuous operations across the organisation.

Our team is based in Denmark and India and consists of five specialists. While supporting our current platforms, we are also executing our roadmap for the next generation of observability capabilities."

• Own and support the day-to-day operation of Saxo's observability platform.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to deliver meaningful monitoring and visibility across business-critical systems.

• Drive priorities, technical direction, and platform improvements within the team.

• Act as the observability platform architect, ensuring scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Swedish Market | Copenhagen Area or Southern Sweden
jobs.description:
Are you fluent in Swedish, based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, and ready to help ambitious restaurants grow? Join DinnerBooking and help us expand our presence in Sweden. 

At DinnerBooking, we are building a booking system that brings restaurants and guests together, and we have a lot of fun along the way. With more than 20 million guest bookings annually and 1,400+ restaurants across 11 markets, we help restaurants reach their full business potential. 

We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Sales Manager based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, for example Malmö or Lund, to grow our customer base in Sweden. You will combine your Swedish language skills and understanding of the market with a structured approach to outbound sales. 

Why join DinnerBooking? 

Besides building a fantastic product, we take pride in our culture. Your ideas matter, your opinions will be heard, and you will be part of a team that supports each other. 

We are problem solvers, colleagues, and friends who want each other to succeed, both professionally and personally. 

Your role 

You will be responsible for identifying and engaging restaurant customers in Sweden. You will join an ambitious international sales team, share ideas and work together to turn opportunities into lasting customer relationships.

Identifying and contacting potential customers in the Swedish restaurant market. 

• 
Starting conversations through outbound calls, emails, and following up. 

• 
Conducting online meetings and product demonstrations in Swedish. 

•

• 
Maintaining a structured and updated pipeline in our CRM system. 

• 
Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding for new customers.

• 
Fluency in Swedish and a good command of English, both spoken and written. 

• 
At least 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience. 

• 
Confidence in opening doors, starting conversations, and building relationships. 

• 
A structured approach to managing your pipeline and following up on opportunities. 

• 
A proactive mindset and the ability to stay motivated and take ownership of your results. 

• 
An empathetic and energetic personality, with a genuine interest in people and their businesses.

Responsibility for sales in Sweden.

An international team with strong commercial experience.

Training in our product, sales approach, and the needs of our restaurant customers.

The opportunity to make a direct impact on our growth in Sweden.

jobs.occupation: Consultant, CFO Services - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
We aim to create futuristic financial departments by assisting businesses in analyzing, implementing, and supporting digital solutions. Would you like to help define what comes next? Supporting the CFO on a path to a more digitalized future is our finest duty. We are looking for consultants, ready to untangle financial knots, lighten the load for our clients and make their future simpler.

About the role

As a consultant in CFO Services, you’ll join a team focused on advancing finance through practical, innovative solutions. You’ll work closely with clients, colleagues, and the latest technologies to solve real challenges and deliver real impact.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Create tailored solutions using the latest digital tools and AI technologies to help clients optimize their finance functions.

• 
Collaborate across disciplines with experts in strategy, risk, compliance, and tech to deliver holistic solutions.

• 
Grow fast through practical experience, structured learning, and mentoring from experienced consultants.

Perks of joining CFO Services

At CFO Services, you won’t just be another consultant, you’ll be part of a close-knit team that’s redefining what it means to work in finance. We combine solid financial know-how with a focus on digital innovation, and we aim to improve how things are done.

We advise both private and public companies in enterprise performance management, process excellence, controls, risk and compliance, finance strategy and transformation, digital finance & finance operation.

We enjoy digging into data to uncover what’s really going on, and in CFO Services we are motivated by helping companies solve challenges that don’t come with a manual.

About you, our new team member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Possess strong analytical skills and an interest in solving financial and digital challenges.

• 
Is motivated by the potential of technology to transform finance functions through automation, reporting, and data-driven insights.

• 
Enjoys working with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams, and value building strong relationships.

• 
Takes ownership of your work and are motivated to continuously learn, develop, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

• 
Thrives in a non-hierarchical culture with a high degree of responsibility and self-management.

• 
Is fluent in both Danish and English, as required by our client portfolio.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
What type of finance-related challenges have you experienced and how have you gained exposure to these challenges (For example: processes, data, systems or compliance). What have you found most interesting and least interesting in working with these challenges?

• 
Describe a situation in which you have achieved something that you are particularly proud of.

• 
Describe how you have managed and prioritized multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Manager, Tanja Tang Pedersen at ttpedersen@kpmg.com

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer for Financial and Non-Financial Risk Areas
jobs.description:
About the role

Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas?

If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo.

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk as well as non-financial areas such as operational risk, model risk and strategic risks in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc.

However, if you are curious about the other areas covered by the team, we will help you develop your skills and knowledge within these areas.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities

• 
Perform compliance risk assessments

• 
Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• 
Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• 
Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• 
Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• 
Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

Your profile

We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas.

Further we expect you to have:

• 
At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• 
A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• 
Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• 
Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation.

It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’.

You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
What accomplishment are you most proud of and why?

• 
What activity gives you most energy and why?

• 
What attracts you most to the associate position in the valuation, financial modelling and energy M&A team?

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Senior Associate, Anna Querol Mercadé at amercade@kpmg.com or Manager, Theis Østergaard at toestergaard@kpmg.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talent at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!
